# latentcov.sbm

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
[![Codecov test coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/Polarolouis/latentcov.sbm/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/Polarolouis/latentcov.sbm)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/Polarolouis/latentcov.sbm/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Polarolouis/latentcov.sbm/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

latentcov.sbm stands for Latent Covariance Between Latent Block in SBM.

This package implements a latent covariance structure between the latent blocks of the Stochastic Block Model to relax the hypothesis of independance between the blocks.

## Installation

You can install the development version of latentcov.sbm from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Polarolouis/latentcov.sbm")
```
